name: Frilled Lizard
canonicalMarkers: huge circular skin frill fanned out behind the head
very long whip tail over half the length
gaping pink mouth at the frill's centre

sourceCoverage.scope: One manually observed sprint painting; no family-wide visual acceptance
sourceCoverage.declarations: External pinnae absent (lizard group fact). Four limbs, frill (neck-owned), head, open lower jaw and the curled tail hand-authored on the exact original. C270 hand-observed a03 jaw follows the painted open-mouth/lower-lip contour; the narrow surrounding head/throat cuff owns the jaw-facing attachment to the frill.
sourceCoverage.limitations: The frill is one neck-owned sheet: it rotates with the neck, it is not separately animated. The open mouth interior is owned by the jaw. Interior root/spine/pelvis/chest are control frames. a01 static RED (idle: exceeds scale compression bound) because the hind-near and fore-far chains were drawn almost straight (path/chord 1.005 and 1.019); a02 places those knees on the visible bend (ratio ≈1.05/1.07), extends the tail-base cap to the rump and the tail-tip cap to the curl end. a03 changes only jaw/head priority polygons. The fixed neck-owned frill is unchanged. This removes the excluded non-nearest jaw/frill cut by routing its anatomical cuff through the existing head owner; no hidden pigment, paint addition, deletion or threshold change.
